pages.title: Void Lattice Block
pages.text: Void lattice shards compacted into a block - a crystal of empty sites that is rigid even though there is nothing in it. Looking at it feels like looking at a hole in the world with very clean edges. It weighs almost nothing.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Pressing void lattice shards together made a block that still had nothing in it but held its shape anyway. It is the strangest building material I have, and it stacks neatly.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Thermodynamics of Information.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Void Lattice Shard.
